instruction: Two-Story Workflow Simulation. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm, workflow.osw and run/eplusout.sql in the task output folder; run the OpenStudio/EnergyPlus workflow so the SQL simulation output is produced. Create 2 building stories, 6 spaces and 6 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Ground North, Ground South, Ground East, Upper North, Upper South and Upper East. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 38 total OS:Surface objects, split into 6 floor surfaces, 6 roof/ceiling surfaces and 26 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 3 Ground, 17 Outdoors and 18 Surface. Add 14 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 92.40 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 6 ideal-loads air systems, 6 zone HVAC equipment lists and 6 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 16.00 m in X, 14.00 m in Y and 7.00 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 448.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 420.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Also save workflow.osw as valid JSON with the top-level keys seed_file, weather_file, measure_paths, steps and run_options and at least 1 workflow step. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
